capabilities: Import Get Notes into Obsidian with incremental sync
Push local note edits, tags, and images back to Get Notes
Sync knowledge bases, subscribed bloggers, and live transcripts
Search cloud content semantically from a sidebar
Generate Canvas boards and timeline views
extras: Free and open-source; OpenAPI quotas limit reads, writes, and note creation; the Playwright channel requires separate installation and is not bundled for mobile.
problem: Obsidian users of 得到大脑 (Get Notes) lack a native way to bring their cloud notes, knowledge bases, blogger content, and live transcripts into their vault or push local edits back.

relations.evidence: A plugin to sync your 得到大脑（原Get笔记） (Get Notes) content into Obsidian
Thanks to the original project jia6y/get-to-obsidian
Playwright: Required only for the desktop Playwright sync channel

requires.name: OpenAPI Client ID and API Key

summary: Importer and bidirectional sync tool for 得到大脑 (Get Notes) content in Obsidian, with incremental sync, semantic search, and Canvas/timeline views.
